claims.description: The structural guard discovers and classifies every remaining production route-entry consent assertion while retaining service-owned granular boundaries.
The production-only mutation and exact restore prove the new tests fail without the three service gates and exhaustive inventory.
The books route regression preserves cached results after withdrawal and refuses before generation on the LLM path.
The original first-session service regressions preserve deterministic matcher returns and refuse before LLM dispatch.
Summary submission and retry tests preserve saved and already-available results while refusing new evaluation and releasing a claimed retry lease.
Recall Bridge tests preserve missing-session and missing-topic returns while refusing immediately before provider routing.
Subject creation tests preserve focused-book and explicit-language deterministic paths and gate the default and unknown discriminants.
Assessment tests preserve app-help and force-review deterministic branches and refuse before LLM evaluation.
Suggestion tests preserve cached and no-subject results and refuse before top-up generation when an LLM call is required.
The exhaustive route assertion inventory prevents a new route-entry consent gate from arriving without an explicit classification.
